name: Reframe
one_liner: App for cutting back on or quitting alcohol: daily lessons on habits and the brain, drink tracking, craving tools and a community.
best_for: Adults who want to drink less, not necessarily quit
People who like daily lessons and tracking to build a new habit
People who want a peer community for accountability
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
Heavy daily drinkers who may need medical help to stop safely (withdrawal can be dangerous)
People who want medication for alcohol use disorder or care from a clinician
People who don't want an app that shares device identifiers for advertising
short_description: Subscription app for drinking less or quitting: a daily education program, drink tracking, craving tools and a peer community.
long_description: Reframe is an app from Glucobit Inc. for people who want to drink less or stop. It describes a neuroscience-based education program delivered in daily lessons, with drink tracking, craving tools and a community. It is free to download, with in-app subscriptions listed on the App Store from $13.99 a month (Reframe Access) and $19.99 a month, or $59.99 to $119.99 a year depending on the tier. Its App Store privacy label says device identifiers are used to track you and for third-party advertising. We found no published study of the Reframe app itself. If you drink heavily every day, stopping suddenly can cause dangerous withdrawal, so talk to a doctor first.
patient_summary: You work through short daily lessons on how alcohol and habits affect you, track your drinks, and use tools for cravings and a peer community. The app is free to download with a paid subscription, listed on the App Store at $19.99 a month or $59.99–$119.99 a year. It is not medical treatment or detox.

pricing.notes: Free to download; App Store in-app purchases also list a cheaper Reframe Access tier at $13.99/month or $79.99/year and higher Silver/Premium tiers. Prices can vary by offer.

privacy.notes: The App Store privacy label says identifiers are used to track you and for third-party advertising; we could not open the full privacy policy to check deletion or HIPAA.

seo.title: Reframe: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Reframe is an app for drinking less or quitting alcohol, built around a 160-day education program, tracking and a private community.

faqs.a: 7-day trial, then about $19.99/month or $59.99–$119.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Reframe before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Reframe replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Reframe is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Reframe is available on iPhone and Android.
160-day education program; Drink tracking; Private community; Craving tools and meditations; Optional coaching.
